talk_ahead.title: Talk Ahead
talk_ahead.def: Faktlar va raqamlar: har bir fakt grafikaga aylanadi (hisoblagich, xarita, AI kadr)
talk_ahead.fits: Talking-head explainer: spiker faktlar va raqamlarni tushuntiradi
talk_ahead.look: Har bir fakt vizualga aylanadi: spiker orqasida matn, hisoblagich, AI insert, real xarita, brend motivli o'tish

pod_glow.title: Pod Glow
pod_glow.def: Podkast va intervyu: ikki qatorli yorqin titr, g'oya kartalari, spiker almashganda oq chaqnash
pod_glow.look: Ikki qatorli key-phrase titr, bitta yonib turadigan aksent, spiker almashganda oq flash, UI uslubidagi kartalar

brand_stage.title: Brand Stage
brand_stage.def: Brend nomidan: vazmin oq titr, brend rangidagi to'liq ekran sahnalar
brand_stage.fits: Bitta spiker brend, studiya yoki agentlik nomidan gapiradi
brand_stage.look: Minimal oq titr, to'liq ekranli brend-rang sahnasi, showcase B-roll, brend-mark sting

case_reel.title: Case Reel
case_reel.def: Case-study reklama: muammo, yechim, natija; raqamlar harakatda
case_reel.fits: Case-study reklama: mijoz uchun erishilgan natija
case_reel.look: Hook → mijoz → muammo → strategiya → natija → CTA shabloni, slot-roll hisoblagich, film-burn o'tish

spotlight_word.title: Spotlight Word
spotlight_word.def: Shaxsiy hikoya: bittadan so'z, muhim so'zlar katta va sariq
spotlight_word.fits: Spiker o'zi, ishi yoki yo'li haqida gapiradigan intro va hikoya
spotlight_word.look: Bittadan oq so'z, kalit so'z katta sariq glow bilan, tile o'tish, metafora split layout

in_scene_type.title: In-Scene Type
in_scene_type.def: Bitta spiker: katta so'zlar kadr ichida, boshning orqasida yoki oldida
in_scene_type.look: Kadr ichida qatlamli matn (bosh orqasida yoki oldida), boshga bog'langan blok, zoom pulse, fizik o'tish

holo_scene.title: Holo Scene
holo_scene.def: Joy yoki mahsulot: haqiqiy yuzalarda gologrammalar va bitta CGI sho'ng'ish
holo_scene.fits: Spiker haqiqiy joyda brend, mahsulot yoki fakt haqida gapiradi (premium agentlik uslubi)
holo_scene.look: Stack titr (kalit so'z bosh orqasida), haqiqiy yuzalarda cyan gologramma, bitta CGI sho'ng'ish, zarrachalardan yig'iladigan ekran

editorial_showcase.title: Editorial Showcase
editorial_showcase.def: Xizmat yoki portfolio: serif matn, hujjat va misol kartalari
editorial_showcase.fits: Bitta spiker xizmat, mahsulot yoki ishni tushuntirib, misollar va portfolio ko'rsatadi
editorial_showcase.look: Serif va qisqa kursiv/qo'lyozma aksent, xabar va matn kartalari, hujjat sahnalari, pastki demo, uch qatorli namoyish va perspektivali panellar

ui_cascade.title: UI Cascade
ui_cascade.def: Ekspert maslahati: harflab yig'iladigan titr, ikonkalar, ilova sahnalari
ui_cascade.fits: Bitta spiker: ekspert yoki kreator muammo, jarayon va odatlar haqida shijoat bilan gapiradi
ui_cascade.look: Harflab yig'iladigan stack titr va bitta magenta kalit so'z, 3D romb ikonkalar, shisha kartalar yelpig'ichi, to'liq ekranli ilova sahnalari (to-do, chat), kesimda negativ-flash
